calibration_guard: 67.4 and 73.04 are two alternative dimensional calibrations of the same fixed orbit and state; they are not merely interchangeable unit rescalings unless every physical clock, matter, Planck and recombination scale is co-rescaled

columns.H: conditional Hubble rate in H_* units
columns.constraint_abs: |R_F|; absolute residual is scale dependent and is not the numerical acceptance metric
columns.constraint_rel: R_F/max(|H^2(3F+3F_q p-Kp^2/2)|,|rho_m+rho_r+V|,tiny); signed normalized Friedmann residual

constraint_gate.interpretation: large absolute residuals at very early N are floating-point cancellation between terms of order 1e100; the dimensionless relative residual is the meaningful numerical gate

status: conditional named two-slope action/state; not a universal P1--P6 history
